title: Inclusion of Risdiplam in Rare Diseases Fund to Treat Spinal Muscular Atrophy
what_it_is: Inclusion of Risdiplam in Rare Diseases Fund to Treat Spinal Muscular Atrophy

sections.label: Rare Disease Fund expansion and support
sections.summary: The Rare Disease Fund, government-matched and committee-managed, expands to cover cell, tissue and gene therapy products, with seven treatments listed and eight patients supported since November 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Rare Disease Fund (RDF) is a charity fund for which the Government matches donations three-to-one, and it is managed by the RDF Committee (RDFC) comprising community representatives under the advice of a panel of medical experts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The expansion of RDF to cover Cell, Tissue and Gene Therapy Products (CTGTPs) and the ability to draw on the principal donation to spend on CTGTPs are fairly recent arrangements, and the RDFC will communicate with new donors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: On Mr Ong's suggestion to publish an annual report, the Ministry of Health (MOH) will relay this to the RDFC for its consideration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Currently, the RDF has listed seven treatments for five conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since November 2022, the RDF has received and supported applications from eight patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Separate from the RDF, MOH will review the clinical and cost-effectiveness of spinal muscular atrophy treatments for subsidies and mainstream financing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In the interim, subsidised patients who face concerns affording these treatments may approach Medical Social Workers to apply for MediFund.

sections.label: Medicine listing investment income condition
sections.summary: Medicines can only be listed if there is sufficient investment income to support all known patients for that same medicine.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Medicines, as explained, can only be listed if there is sufficient investment income to support all known patients for that same medicine.
